role: You are Grace, Operations Manager for GTT Center Perth. You draft the test-morning procedure for the partner lab to approve. It is a draft, not a clinical protocol.

inline_inputs.label: Patient flow for one client (CLINICAL-OPERATIONS-PLAN.md section 2.1, with the locked facts winning)
inline_inputs.text: About 10 minutes before her appointment: arrives fasting. Check-in, request check, Medicare card (Path B), two ID checks (name and date of birth). T+0: first draw (fasting), about 5 minutes, then the 75 g drink within 5 minutes. Service 1 between draws. A buffer, then escort back seated. T+60 exactly: second draw. Service 2. Buffer. T+120 exactly: third draw; she may leave only after it. After the third draw a snack is offered straight away. Tube for every draw: grey-top (fluoride oxalate). The locked facts win over this on service length: Package 1 has 2 services of 30 minutes, Package 2 up to 45 minutes each.

inline_inputs.label: Fasting and seated rules (CLINICAL-OPERATIONS-PLAN.md sections 2.3 and 2.4)
inline_inputs.text: Fasting 10 to 12 hours, water only. No food, gum, mints, juice, coffee, nicotine, or exercise that morning. If she is not fasted, do not start; the venue manager decides and she reschedules. The partner lab wants the client to stay at the collection centre for the whole test. Our draft rule: escort her seated, low-activity services only, no exercise, no leaving the premises, one staff member responsible. Open point (whether she must stay in the lab's sightline): the partner lab decides.

inline_inputs.label: Round 21 door and record steps (GRACE-R21-BOOKING-FLOW-PART-1.md section 4, GRACE-R21-COMPUTER-FILING.md section 3, GRACE-R21-MIDWIFE-SLOTS.md section 6)
inline_inputs.text:
Door check by the venue manager from 06:30: a request is there (original, phone, or the client's photo), the name matches the booking, a date is on it. She does not judge if it is medically right. The phlebotomist checks the request is for the pregnancy glucose test and meets the lab's rules (what the lab accepts: NOT IN REPO), then ticks outside request checked in Today. Missing flag: no draw. Unsure: ask the midwife (on site from 08:00) or phone the lab. Path B clients with a same-morning consult see the midwife first and stay fasted. Staff never write, copy or fix a request.
Results: the lab sends results to the requesting midwife for Path B; who receives Path A results is NOT IN REPO. A normal result is announced by a generic ready message; the midwife phones only abnormal results. GTT does not take over diabetes care.

deliverable.format: Exactly 14 numbered headings, each with 2 to 4 short lines: 1 Arrival, 2 ID and request check, 3 Fasting check, 4 First draw and draw window, 5 The drink, 6 Timing marks, 7 Waiting area, 8 Each draw, 9 No strenuous activity, 10 Adverse events, 11 Labelling, 12 Transport, 13 Departure, 14 Results.
deliverable.write_only: the 14 headings and Questions for Anthony
deliverable.do_not_write: a tube type that is not in the inputs, drink contents not in the inputs, any clinical decision, a venue-manager start of 07:00

extra_checks: Heading 1 uses the late rule word for word.
Heading 14 says the lab sends results to the requesting midwife and GTT does not take over diabetes care.
Anything the partner lab must decide is written as: the partner lab decides.
